claire_ops: FYI — Acme Corp signed for a Private (VPC) air-gapped cluster. Need a single bring-up runbook covering bootstrap, validation, and handoff. Timeline: target cluster ready in 2 weeks. Who can own drafting the playbook?

rahul_infra: I can own the runbook. I'll post an operational checklist, offline artifact flow, validation tests, and a handoff checklist. Posting an initial draft here for feedback.

rahul_infra: PRE-DELIVERY CHECK (to confirm with delivery + customer)
- Hardware inventory: node list, NICs, BMC/iDRAC, GPU type (A100/RTX6000), PSU.
- Firmware & BIOS: customer to set baseline (BIOS fw x.y.z, BMC fw a.b.c).
- Network: dedicated management subnet, pod subnet, service CIDR, DNS, NTP.
- Power & racking: PDUs, labeling, serial console access.
- Compliance: HSM/KMS placement, allowed IPs for support jump-host.

rahul_infra: ONSITE BOOTSTRAP (high level)
1) Physically verify cable/labels and BMC access to each node.
2) Provision a secure customer bastion (supports scp/usbm) inside their management VLAN.
3) Mirror container images + OS packages to offline mirror (s3-like dir or local registry).
4) Install drivers (NVIDIA) and container runtime with nvidia-container-toolkit.
5) Run kubeadm join / or install k8s via offline manifests.

rahul_infra: AIR-GAP ARTIFACT MIRROR (example commands)
- On our build box (online):
```
# mirror images to a tarball dir
skopeo copy --dest-tls-verify=false docker://registry.redwood/models:prod dir:/tmp/mirror/models
skopeo copy --dest-tls-verify=false docker://registry.redwood/runtime:latest dir:/tmp/mirror/runtime
# package OS repos
rsync -avz /var/cache/yum/ repo-mirror:/tmp/os-mirror/
```
- Deliver / transfer to customer bastion (signed checksums, PGP-signed manifest).

rahul_infra: OFFLINE REGISTRY SETUP (on customer bastion)
```
# create local registry
docker run -d -p 5000:5000 --restart=always --name registry registry:2
# load mirrored images
for f in /tmp/mirror/models/*.tar; do docker load -i "$f"; docker tag $(docker images --format "{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}" | head -1) localhost:5000/$(basename "$f" .tar); docker push localhost:5000/$(basename "$f" .tar); done
```
(we'll provide a curated image list; keep repo read-only after mirror)

rahul_infra: GPU DRIVER + RUNTIME (validation snippets)
```
# install NVIDIA driver (example)
sudo dpkg -i NVIDIA-Linux-*.deb
# verify
nvidia-smi
# container test
docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.8-base nvidia-smi
```
Expected: nvidia-smi lists all GPUs with correct driver version.

deploy-bot: Provision job 76823 started for acme-onprem-01 (job_id=76823) :rocket:

ben_security: Two quick items
- KMS: For air-gapped we need customer KMS or HSM on-prem; plan for Vault in transit vs sealed auto-unseal via HSM.
- Support access: require customer-managed jump host and ssh bastion with recorded sessions (no direct internet egress).

sarah_pmo: What's the acceptance criteria for handoff to customer success? Need measurable items.

rahul_infra: Handoff / Acceptance criteria (suggested)
- All nodes are Ready in k8s: `kubectl get nodes` shows status Ready for control-plane and workers.
- GPU device plugin present and correct: `kubectl -n kube-system get ds | grep nvidia-device-plugin` -> DESIRED=READY.
- Offline registry reachable from nodes: `curl http://localhost:5000/v2/_catalog` returns repo list.
- Sample inference job passes: launch the envoy/sidecar + model container with a small load test (100 concurrent requests, p50 < 150ms) using `wrk` or `hey`.
- Network e2e: control-plane -> worker ping/ssh, pod -> pod traffic, DNS resolution for service names.
- Security: KMS reachable for unseal, audit logging enabled, and support jump-host reviewed.

rahul_infra: SAMPLE VALIDATION COMMANDS
```
# k8s readiness
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=nvidia-device-plugin
# gpu smoke test
kubectl run --rm -it gpu-test --restart=Never --image=localhost:5000/nvidia-cuda:11.8 --limits="nvidia.com/gpu=1" -- /bin/bash -c "nvidia-smi"
# service test
kubectl run -it --rm loadtest --image=localhost:5000/wrk -- /bin/sh -c "wrk -t2 -c100 -d30s http://svc-model.default.svc.cluster.local/predict"
```
Make sure to capture logs: `kubectl logs -n default deploy/model` and `journalctl -u kubelet` if node issues.

customer-eng: For firewall rules they'll ask for exact IPs/ranges — can you paste a minimal sample?

rahul_infra: SAMPLE IP / FW NOTES
- Management VLAN: 10.10.0.0/24 (customer provides) -> allow SSH (22), HTTPS (443) from support jump host only.
- Pod CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16 -> internally routed, block from mgmt except API server IPs.
- Service CIDR: 10.96.0.0/12
- NTP: allow udp/123 to customer's NTP pool.
- DNS: allow 53 to internal DNS & block external DNS by default.
- Outbound egress: disabled; allow only registry-bastion -> internal registry (5000) and KMS ports.

claire_ops: This is great. Rahul, please turn this into a one-page runbook + checklist and a 2-step handoff doc for CS. Need it in 48h. I'll pair you with Sarah for timing.

rahul_infra: Will do. I'll post the final markdown runbook to the repo and ping ops@redwood when done. Requesting sample kubeadm config from platform team to bake in control-plane details.

sarah_pmo: I'll block time with Acme's delivery lead for Thursday 10-11am PT.
